youtube.title: Jesus Knew Who Would Betray Him. He Washed Their Feet | Bible Story
youtube.line1: Jesus washing the disciples' feet in the Bible (John 13): He knew Judas would betray Him, and still tied a towel around Himself and washed their feet.
youtube.line2: "For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean." In plain words: He knew about Judas, and He washed their feet anyway. Later that night He told Peter that before morning Peter would say three times that he did not know Him (John 13:38).
